Name: Amalek
Description: The region of the Amalekites, who fought Israel at Rephidim, dwelt in the land of the south, and returned again and again as Israel's enemy from the wilderness through the days of the judges.
BiblicalSignificance: Amalek is Israel's first enemy after the Red Sea: the battle Moses watched with uplifted hands, and the name God said would be blotted out for attacking the faint and weary.
KeyScriptures: Exodus 17:8; Exodus 17:9; Exodus 17:10; Exodus 17:11; Exodus 17:13; Exodus 17:14; Exodus 17:16; Numbers 13:29; Numbers 24:20; Deuteronomy 25:17; Deuteronomy 25:19; Judges 3:13; Judges 5:14; Judges 6:3; Judges 6:33
